repo_notes.content: A GitHub starter template, not an npm package: package.json is marked private. Readers arrive intending to clone it.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: The wiki should read as a build guide for someone starting from this template, not as API reference for a library.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: Template Overview
pages.purpose: What this template gives you, what it deliberately leaves out, and the shape of an application built from it.

pages.title: Agent Core
pages.purpose: The agent implementation under src/agent/: the run loop, tool dispatch, memory access and the observability hooks around each step.

pages.title: Worked Examples
pages.purpose: The four example agents in examples/ — autonomous research, research, customer service and code generation — and what each demonstrates.

pages.title: Policy and Security
pages.purpose: The policy binding that constrains what an agent may do, and the security posture the template assumes.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The Vitest layout: unit tests, agent tests and integration tests, and how to extend them for your own agent.

pages.title: Architecture and Compatibility
pages.purpose: The design decisions recorded in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and the version compatibility matrix.
